head.h1: Family Feast Package Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

Popular directions include Italian and Mediterranean sharing boards, an Arabic mezze-to-mixed-grill feast, a slow-roast centrepiece, or a modern mix across cuisines. The food is designed to travel from kitchen to table in waves, so courses land hot and the table never empties. Halal, vegetarian and vegan versions are standard, not extras: tell us who is eating and the chef adjusts the menu instead of bolting on a side plate. Gluten-free options are available on request, subject to partner confirmation and an allergen review for the specific booking, and menus without intentionally added nuts may be available the same way. Family feast package food catering in Dubai is about abundance done well, not a buffet line.

new_paragraphs: How much does a family feast package cost in Dubai?

How many guests does the family feast package serve?
Six to eight guests as standard. For a bigger table, the chef scales the menu and can add a service assistant, and the price is confirmed for your exact numbers.
What's included in the price?
Everything for the dinner: menu design, a vetted chef, on-site cooking, full table service, and setup and cleanup. There is no separate labour or call-out charge on top.
Can the menu be halal, vegetarian or allergen-aware?

Yes. Halal, vegetarian and vegan menus are standard. Gluten-free, nut-conscious and other dietary menu options may be available on request, subject to confirmation by the assigned culinary partner. Partner kitchens may handle allergens, and cross-contact cannot be completely excluded unless dedicated controls have been specifically confirmed for the booking. Guests with allergies must provide full details before confirming their event.
Do you bring equipment and clean up?
Yes. The chef cooks in your kitchen, brings any specialist kit needed, serves each course, and leaves the kitchen clean. You are left with the table and the company, not the washing-up.
Which areas of Dubai do you cover?
All of Dubai — Palm Jumeirah, Downtown, Dubai Marina, Emirates Hills, Jumeirah, Business Bay and beyond. The chef travels to your villa or apartment.

Send your date, guest count and venue and we match a vetted chef, then return an itemised proposal — usually within one business day. Approve it and the date is yours.
